title: Can barely see any Herringbone pattern in the fabric.
text:
Can barely see any Herringbone pattern in the fabric.. The color Yellow of these throw pillow covers is more of a muted yellow, not bright, but nice, and
I do like the color.
There made well, No loose threads, and the zipper works very good, but its not what I would call a hidden zipper!
The fabric seems thick.

This said it is Herringbone pattern, it is So tiny you need a magnifying mirror to see it, it actually looks like a plain fabric.
The reason I bought these, was it said a Herringbone pattern, Not.

I’m not impressed.
Made in India.
